crossRefs.note: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy…
“ ‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made…
“You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

translations.web: “ ‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
translations.bsb: These are the LORD’s appointed feasts, the sacred assemblies you are to proclaim at their appointed times.
translations.kjv: These are the feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
translations.asv: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.
